name: org.algorand.shopping.payment_handler
title: Algorand Payment Handler
description: UCP payment handler enabling checkout payments via Algorand (ALGO native currency and Algorand Standard Assets). Supports MainNet, TestNet and BetaNet. Merchant provides receiver address and accepted assets; platform submits a signed Algorand transaction and supplies the confirmed transaction ID as the payment credential.

AlgorandAddress.description: A valid Algorand base32-encoded public address (58 uppercase alphanumeric chars).

id.description: Algorand Standard Asset ID. Use 0 to represent native ALGO.

symbol.description: Human-readable ticker symbol (e.g. ALGO, USDC, USDT).

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for this asset.

receiver_address.description: The merchant's Algorand address that must receive the payment.

accepted_assets.description: List of ALGO or ASAs this merchant accepts. Platforms MUST use one of these for payment.

memo_field.description: Specifies what the transaction note/memo field must contain. 'ucp_checkout_id' means the platform MUST set the tx note to the UCP checkout session ID (UTF-8, base64-encoded). Required for merchant-side verification.

escrow_app_id.description: Optional Algorand application ID of the PaymentEscrow smart contract. When present, platforms MUST route payment through the escrow contract rather than directly to receiver_address.

min_confirmations.description: Minimum number of confirmed Algorand rounds before the business considers the payment final. 1 round (~4 seconds) is sufficient for most use cases given Algorand's immediate finality.

indexer_url.description: Optional public Algorand indexer endpoint the platform can use to verify transaction status before calling complete_checkout.

AlgorandPaymentInstrument.description: An available payment instrument for the Algorand handler.

type.description: 'algo' for native ALGO payments; 'asa' for Algorand Standard Assets.

asset_ids.description: When type='asa', restricts acceptable ASA IDs. If absent, any opted-in ASA is acceptable.

AlgorandCredential.description: The payment credential that the platform submits in complete_checkout. Contains the confirmed Algorand transaction ID and the network it was submitted on.

txid.description: The confirmed Algorand transaction ID (base32-encoded, 52 uppercase alphanumeric characters). This is the transaction that transferred ALGO or ASA to the merchant's receiver_address.

network.description: The Algorand network on which the transaction was submitted. MUST match the handler config's network.

asset_id.description: The ASA ID used for this payment. 0 for native ALGO. MUST match one of the merchant's accepted_assets.

round.description: Optional: the confirmed Algorand round number. Allows the business to quickly fetch transaction details without a full indexer search.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Algorand Payment
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Extends the UCP checkout schema to declare Algorand as a payment instrument. Platforms that support Algorand will include an AlgorandCredential in the complete_checkout request.
